limitations.title: Metering Basis Unverified
limitations.desc: Training generation reflects unverified AC vs DC net metering semantics. System derates must not be applied on a verified basis.

limitations.title: Prospective Roof Lag Policy
limitations.desc: Phase 5 ML models require historical yield lag features. Prospective unbuilt roofs lack empirical yield and evaluate to PREDICTION_PENDING_LAG_POLICY.

limitations.title: Procurement Pricing Unpopulated
limitations.desc: The Phase 6 panel catalogue contains verified physical and thermal specs, but commercial panel pricing is unpopulated. Financial evaluations require explicit user cost ledgers.

limitations.title: Inverter Specifications Unpopulated
limitations.desc: The catalogue currently does not store matched inverter records. Electrical compatibility requires user-supplied inverter datasheets.

limitations.title: Commercial Training Support Range
limitations.desc: 86.4% of Phase 5 training arrays cluster between 21.39 and 100 kWp. Residential arrays (< 21.39 kWp) represent unsupported extrapolations and are quarantined in Pareto ranking.

limitations.title: Known Melbourne campus sites only
limitations.desc: Temporal evaluation on observed UNISOLAR Campus 1 sites; no validation for India, new regions or residential roofs.

limitations.title: Geometric feasibility only
limitations.desc: No structural, regulatory or electrical installation approval.
